title: conradia calycina
intro: Conradia calycina, commonly known as "Bitter Calyce", is a plant species that belongs to the family Apocynaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of various conditions. The bioactive constituents present in Conradia calycina include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
